_what: Settings for harness/claude-limits.mjs: how a Claude subscription's limits are recorded as provider_limits rows. header_reader is "off" until the reader is pointed at the proxy's usage queue (response_headers per request) and the coordinator confirms it; no probes are sent to read them. The words source is on now. A header row is "limited" only when its own Status is "rejected": overage-status is not a limit (it is rejected whenever org-level overage is off).

sources.headers: anthropic rate-limit response headers (the proxy passes them through)

upsert_sql: insert into provider_limits (provider, account, window_name, used_percent, resets_at, read_at, source, state) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) on conflict (provider, account, window_name) do update set used_percent = excluded.used_percent, resets_at = excluded.resets_at, read_at = excluded.read_at, source = excluded.source, state = excluded.state
table: public.provider_limits (window is a reserved word, so the column is window_name)
